routing_warnings.description: This message changes the static package display so it shows prices by square-footage range; it does not resume or modify the deferred instant quote calculator.
The implementation claim concerns revisions to the Pricing page rather than implementation of the instant quote calculator.
The client's acceptance of the current pricing approach concerns the mobile pricing-table interaction rather than the package rates or square-footage tiers.
Reducing the homepage blue overlay to emphasize its image is specific to the homepage hero presentation, not the site-wide visual-focus constraint.
The offer to provide photographs for the homepage, Services page, and other sections concerns the source of site imagery.
The client delegates selection of supplied photographs for non-gallery pages rather than changing the site-wide image-focused presentation.
The claim that all images were updated concerns replacement and placement of supplied image content, not implementation of the broader visual-emphasis constraint.
The requested stock-photo replacements and use of a supplied house photograph concern specific image content rather than the site-wide image-focused design principle.
The offer to supply photos for the Services page and other sections concerns the source of site imagery, not whether every service has a corresponding representative image.
The broad claim that all images were updated does not specifically establish service-to-image correspondence and is better evaluated under the client-supplied site imagery Requirement.
The requested replacement of stock photos with client-supplied photos concerns image source and selection rather than representative imagery for each offered service.
This message changes package prices by square-footage range rather than the individual-service pricing breakdown.
This pricing-page revision follows the package and square-footage pricing exchange and is better routed to the package-tier pricing Requirement.
The implementation claim concerns placing a video on the Gallery page, not the category-filter mechanism.
The mobile layout concern specifically targets the pricing table rather than the general responsive site layout.
The request to disable hover animations on mobile targets the portfolio hover behavior rather than the general responsive site layout.
The client delegates image selection for the homepage and other non-gallery pages, rather than changing gallery image content.
The remaining stock-photo replacements and requested homepage house image concern non-gallery site sections.
The separate claim that the gallery problem was fixed belongs to the gallery browsing Requirement.
The request to link homepage portfolio tiles to the gallery belongs to the portfolio-tile linking Requirement.
The same message explicitly removes the video from the homepage while retaining it in the Gallery.
This implementation claim concerns preparation of the Get a Quote form design, not the destination behavior of the Book a Session CTA.
The client's approval concerns the completed Get a Quote page design and does not verify that the Book a Session CTA routes to that page.
